name: [RNG🎲]Animal Evolution
desc:
The animal world where the strong is king meets RNG 🎲

🦕Play as different animals. Eat everything on this land to make yourself bigger.
👑Eat other players to become the biggest animal king.
🔒Eat more  to get more chances to hatch eggs and unlock more animals.
📖Collect more animals to unlock index to increase your luck.
🔥Merge the same animals to increase boost and rewards.

🧬Eat more! Glorious evolution!
